scope: An explicit new Stage 4 composition verifies the complete original generic Flock execution proof and directly discharges every original deferred claim. It replaces only Stage 4 adapter-generated auxiliary folds, not original proof checks. The small packed scalar class is a diagnostic, not a scalable Stage 2 guest profile.

source_archive.scope: Frozen isolated native-workspace source used on the CPU host. Includes the complete closure implementation and pre-C0-storage-optimization FFLONK source; the census does not preprocess a key or use C0.

composition.main_relation_unchanged: The original transcript/PoW, S=H4(P,B,I,O), public Q=H5(P,B,O), zerocheck/lincheck, Product-GKR wiring, merged PCS/ring switch/multipoint/untwisted checks and inner Ligerito/Merkle checks use the same private shared emitter body.
composition.direct_closure: All 64 matrix low weights and high-point prefixes are shared only when their constrained bit wires are identical. Structure evaluates the complete eight-plane setup table with shared suffix wires. Jagged evaluates both scaled equality rows and every combination term at a shared constrained column point. Every original claim value is equated in-circuit to its exact evaluation.
composition.setup_ownership: Only approved replay/setup data compile immutable tables and topology. Every table ID, ordered claim set, geometry and source payload is checked before allocation. No guest/proof/table hint/native acceptance bit chooses topology. Compilation errors never select the legacy fold route as a fallback.

whole_census.test_pass_means: The bounded diagnostic successfully returned and checked a typed domain refusal. It does not mean the circuit fit, an assignment was checked, or a terminal proof was generated.
whole_census.warning: The first refused prefix exceeded the cap by one row, but substantial matrix work and the structure/jagged checks remained. Neither a one-row reduction nor a sum of separately allocated component counts is a demonstrated full fit.

host_and_limits.rust_toolchain: Existing rustup 1.98.0; no Rust installation or user configuration change.
host_and_limits.measurement_scope: Matrix-free setup/constraint projection, not full R1CS, witness, key, SRS, FFT, or scratch allocation. Low census RSS is not a prover peak or whole-pipeline admission.

native_prefix_regression.programs_and_inputs: Local-return false, local-return true, and a different literal-return image under one approved packed small-class setup.
checks: Complete immutable setup rebuilt identically before proofs.
Direct setup prefix equals legacy-fold setup prefix and each assigned native prefix.
All table identities/coverage/geometry preflight; malformed table sets reject without emission.
Source payload, materialized row, and tiny PLONK budgets reject with sticky errors; setup/assigned refusal agreement.
All component evaluations agree with independently computed native field/table values.
native_prefix_regression.scope: Real Stage 3 proof/replay plus bounded Stage 4 prefixes, not complete circuit identity, assignment satisfaction, or a Stage 4 proof.

component_scope: Each setup-only and assigned component census completed with exactly equal R1CS projection and PLONK census. Components independently allocate their inputs/claims and exclude the main verifier; they cannot be summed into a whole-relation count. Measurements preceded lint-only checked-conversion cleanup; program digests and native prefix identity were rechecked with the final frozen source.

regressions.scope: Includes the independently committed derived-C0 storage optimization. Synthetic materialized gadgets test literal coefficients, false claims, every claim/output bit, identical setup/assigned matrices, strict wire-identity sharing, malformed geometry/coverage and fail-closed limits. No full Exec relation proof was generated.
